content.title: Shrinking Secures Season 4 Renewal from Apple TV+ Before Season 3 Premiere
content.text: While fans await the premiere of Shrinking season 3, Apple TV+ has good news for Jimmy and Louis’ fans: the streaming giant has renewed the series for Season 4.While details are still thin for the fourth season, here’s what to know about Season 3. It comprises 11 episodes, which will be set around the theme of “moving forward,” and will pick up right after Season 2’s finale, which focused on the theme of forgiveness. Jimmy prepares her daughter Alice for college while navigating his emotions and channelling energy toward healing. It will also see Paul grappling with Parkinson’s, seeking treatment, and meeting a character played by Michael J. Fox. Apple TV+(Apple TV+)For fans’ reminder: the finale for the second season saw Jimmy saving Louis (Brett Goldstein) – responsible for his wife Tia’s death – from a suicide attempt at the train station.Apart from series regulars like Jason Segel (Jimmy), Harrison Ford (Dr. Paul), Jessica Williams (Gaby), and Luke Tennie (Sean), Season 3 features guest stars like Goldstein, Fox, Damon Wayans Jr., Wendie Malick, Cobie Smulders, Jeff Daniels, Candice Bergen, Sherry Cola, and Isabella Gomez.Following the early renewal, more Season 4 details will emerge as Season 3 nears its finale.Season 3 premieres on January 28, 2026, with a one-hour Episode 1 available on Apple TV+. New episodes drop weekly every Wednesday at around 9 p.m. ET until the finale on April 8.Related: Apple TV+ Announces Premiere Date for ‘Shrinking’ Season 3
